children: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. Sponsored ADR (NSE:DRREDDY) posted mixed Q2 FY27 results with revenue down ~1% but margins and profits beating estimates, highlighted by rising gross margin and product launches, while eyeing semaglutide ramp and an abatacept U.S. decision for FY2028.
Previous Week Recap
Dr. Reddy's Q2 FY27 Revenue Decline, Profit Drop
: DRREDDY Q2 FY27: revenue ₹8,670–8,671 crore (down ~1% YoY), net profit ₹913–925 crore (down ~36% YoY). EBITDA margin 20.6%; EBITDA and PAT beat estimates. Sequential revenue +7.4%, profit +109%.
DRREDDY Expects U.S. Abatacept Decision December 2026
: Dr. Reddy's (DRREDDY) expects a U.S. decision on its intravenous abatacept biosimilar in Dec 2026. Company targets U.S. and EU launches, with sales contributing from fiscal 2028 onward.
DRREDDY Gross Margin Hits 51.7%
: DRREDDY gross margin rose to 51.7%, the highest since gRevlimid lost exclusivity, signaling improved near-term profitability for the ADR.
Dr. Reddy's Semaglutide Pens Launch Plan
: Dr. Reddy's (DRREDDY) plans to sell 6–7M semaglutide pens this year and sees a long‑term market of 12–15M pens, starting commercialization in Canada and select international markets.
DRREDDY FDA Srikakulam Unit Inspection VAI
: Dr. Reddy's ADR (DRREDDY) says FDA closed its Srikakulam Process Unit‑02 inspection with a Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classification following a prior pre‑approval/GMP check.
Dr. Reddy's H1 FY27 North America Filings
: Dr. Reddy's (DRREDDY) launched 12 products and filed 10 ANDAs in North America in H1 FY27. Pipeline holds ~80 filings, including 27 first-to-file opportunities and 3 NDAs.
NPPA Cuts Azacitidine MRP in India
: Dr. Reddy's ADR (DRREDDY): India’s NPPA cut MRP for Azacitidine 100 mg (Azacytin) single pack from Rs 6,337 to Rs 1,495.04, effective Nov. 9. Price change part of NPPA oncology adjustments.
JPMorgan Neutral On DRREDDY; Margin, Pipeline Catalysts
: JPMorgan raised Dr. Reddy's (DRREDDY) to Neutral, citing improved margins and near-term pipeline catalysts, while noting risks from the semaglutide ramp and abatacept timing.
India Business Rises To Eighth In Pharma
: DRREDDY: India business rose to eighth in pharma, driven by oncology launches, newly licensed therapies and improved product execution, aiding a turnaround in the segment.
